Sandbox_ServerM8_DisplayName_tooltip: Name shown at the top of the dashboard. Leave empty to use the server's public name.
Sandbox_ServerM8_Tagline_tooltip: One short line shown under the server name.
Sandbox_ServerM8_Welcome_tooltip: Shown on the dashboard's Overview tab. Longer text belongs in Zomboid/Lua/ServerM8_news.txt on the server.
Sandbox_ServerM8_DiscordInvite_tooltip: A permanent invite link or code, for example https://discord.gg/abc123. Players open it inside the game through the Steam overlay.
Sandbox_ServerM8_DiscordServerID_tooltip: The numeric server ID. Requires 'Enable Server Widget' in your Discord server settings. Adds a live preview showing who is online without logging in.
Sandbox_ServerM8_Website_tooltip: A full https:// address. Adds a Website button to the dashboard.
Sandbox_ServerM8_ShowOnJoin_tooltip: Show the dashboard once each time a player connects.
Sandbox_ServerM8_ShowActivity_tooltip: Show recent joins, leaves and deaths on the dashboard.
